# AI & Coffee — Small Business AI Workshop & Agent Ecosystem

> AI & Coffee is a hands-on 60-minute workshop hosted by Zoth Studio Team (nullai.tech) at Lynnhaven Coffee Co. in Virginia Beach. Local contractors, realtors, bakers, and small business owners build real, working AI texting helpers to automate lead qualification, customer FAQ replies, appointment bookings, and invoice follow-ups.

## Summary & Key Information

- **Title**: AI & Coffee | Small Business AI Workshop by Tech Pro
- **Instructor & Guide**: Zoth Studio Team (Full-Stack Engineer & Automation Architect at nullai.tech)
- **Publisher**: Tech Pro (757tech.pro)
- **Venue**: Lynnhaven Coffee Co., 2945 Shore Dr, Virginia Beach, VA 23451
- **Live URL**: https://aiandcoffee.757tech.pro
- **Portfolio Showcase**: https://nullai.tech
- **Core Technology Stack**: HTML5, Modern CSS Glassmorphism, Three.js WebGL particle mesh, Vanilla JavaScript, Supabase, Web Audio API, Stripe Micropayments, Hermes AI Agent ecosystem.

## Target Audience & Scenarios

1. **Freelancers & Tech Consultants**: Triage incoming inquiries, share project discovery call links, check invoice payment status.
2. **Realtors**: Answer listing & neighborhood questions, collect buyer budgets and timelines, qualify leads 24/7.
3. **Contractors & Solo Trades**: Answer diagnostic trip fees, capture job site photos/addresses, schedule calendar estimates.
4. **Salons & Spa Owners**: Manage haircut/color appointment openings, send text reminders, answer service pricing.
5. **Fitness Coaches**: Handle class schedule questions, collect trial signups, follow up with inactive leads.
6. **Cleaning & Lawn Care Services**: Give square-footage quotes, confirm access details, schedule recurring service routes.

## Workshop Curriculum (60 Minutes)

1. **0:00 - 0:10 (10 min)**: What AI Can Actually Do for Local Business — Real case studies across Hampton Roads.
2. **0:10 - 0:30 (20 min)**: Interactive Hands-On Testing — Practice with real customer messages and prompt tuning.
3. **0:30 - 0:50 (20 min)**: Build Your Helper — Configure business FAQs, pricing rules, boundaries, and scheduling triggers.
4. **0:50 - 1:00 (10 min)**: Deploy & Take Away — Connect helper to business SMS lines with 30-day free trial.

## Pricing Structure

- **Group Class Workshop Ticket**: $99 one-time (Includes 60-min live session, free coffee & pastry voucher, takeaway guide, 30-day free trial).
- **Private 1-on-1 Session**: $299 per session (Dedicated setup tailored to custom CRM/WhatsApp/SMS integrations).
- **Autopilot Retainer Options**:
  - Starter Helper: $19/mo (24/7 Q&A answering & custom AI training)
  - Autopilot Pro: $39/mo (Booking triggers, SMS follow-ups, daily lead summaries)
  - Social & Media: $79/mo (Graphic design, video reel promos, voice generation)
